Zeus on Our Manuscripts

Zeus on our manuscripts

Zeus reads a cropped staff and writes out the music. Below, its newest single-staff model (ayce, August 2026) reads 11 test staves from four sources, with no training on our hands.

Model: OmniOMR/zeus, CC BY-NC-SA weights. The staves are straightened and cropped from the staff's left end to its right end. Zeus never reads our alto clefs (it guesses treble or bass), so each reading is shown in the part's clef: same staff positions, the clef swapped and the pitches moved to match. Its own reading is underneath. "Black and white" uses ink below 72% of paper brightness. Rendered with Verovio. Compare each scan with the notation under it.
